purpose: Freeze newly received external replies before any quantitative reuse or new physical interpretation.

facts: BODC confirms free web-user access is the intended download route for series 1762365.
Originator files such as em122.ACO may be requestable through BODC enquiries even when not routinely published.
BODC confirms MBANSWCB was present in em122.ACO but was not transferred into final processed series 1762365.
Only single-beam echosounder depth was retained in final series because it was judged the cleanest and most accurate bathymetry-depth source during final screening.
BGS states the requested H10N1/H10S2 locations are beyond the data that BGS collected.
BGS refers bathymetry coverage questions to UK Hydrographic Office.
BGS separately refers to BODC cruise record 15726 as another relevant survey route.
BODC/NOC says TOBI-02 data are held on offline tape storage and can be retrieved to a virtual copy for delivery.
Retrieval cannot start until Thursday because of work in the tape-storage room.
Tape retrieval normally takes at least 24 hours; earliest expected delivery is mid-next week after the bank-holiday weekend.
replies.source_text_discrepancy: Reply says CD196 while original request was CD169; treat as unresolved identifier discrepancy before using any delivered files.
